response: Yes, IgM-enriched immunoglobulins have been shown to be an effective adjuvant in septic very low birth weight (VLBW) infants. Studies have demonstrated that the administration of IgM-enriched immunoglobulins can reduce the incidence of sepsis, improve survival rates, and decrease the need for intensive care in this high-risk population. The IgM-enriched immunoglobulins provide additional antimicrobial activity and may help to mitigate the inflammatory response associated with sepsis, thereby improving outcomes in septic VLBW infants.
